name: Comedy Armor
summary: If you're already the joke, nothing hits as hard. Minor DR and evasion.

name: Jester's Luck
summary: The universe finds Bin entertaining. Slightly better luck and crits.

name: Frozen Aura
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. A chilling aura toughens the bearer slightly.

name: Rabid Frenzy
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. Faster but reckless — strikes hard but accepts more incoming damage.

name: Alpha Aura
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. Pack leader. Nearby allies share its resolve.

name: Swift Step
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. Quick on its feet — dodges more often.

name: Tough Hide
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. Hardened skin grants +DR and bulk.

name: Hungry Bite
summary: Procedural enemy modifier. Each bite restores a sliver of its own HP.

name: Sword Mastery
summary: +10% physical damage. Trained on sword forms (the engine applies it whenever physical damage is dealt; restrict by weapon when conditional…

name: Warrior's Resolve
summary: Below 30% HP: enrages, +20% damage. Hooks the existing on_low_hp berserk effect.

name: Shield Brace
summary: +3 physical DR (the Knight braces even outside the defend round; defend still adds the action-economy bonus on top).

name: Bulwark
summary: +1 DR vs all damage types.

name: Indomitable
summary: Immune to fear and charm.

name: Rage Buildup
summary: +5% crit chance baseline. (Per-round stacking will swap in once on_turn_end stacking is supported.)

name: Bloodlust
summary: Heal 5% max HP on kill.

name: Frenzy
summary: Below 50% HP: +30% damage (uses the existing berserk_low_hp hook).

name: Dodge Step
summary: +5% evasion.

name: Backstab
summary: +10% physical damage. (Conditional surrounded-target bonus wires once that trigger is added.)

name: Eagle Eye
summary: +1 range to skills and basic attacks.

name: Marksman
summary: +15% physical damage. (Range-conditional bonus wires once that trigger is added.)

name: Abominable
summary: Mythic, nearly unkillable. Mundane weapons cannot harm it; only enchanted, fire, or boss-tier abilities deal real damage.

name: Alpha Presence
summary: Pack alpha. Nearby wolves deal more damage.

name: Climber
summary: Can scale walls and obstacles as if they were open ground. Cover does not protect against this enemy.

name: Demonic Might
summary: Hellish strength. Every blow lands harder.

name: Fae Blood
summary: Hidden Fae heritage. Natural mana recovery and magic resistance.

name: Frostbitten Flesh
summary: The cold preserves it. Immune to frost, but fire burns away its flesh faster.

name: Frozen Carapace
summary: The chimera's frostfire-hardened scales. High DR and reflects damage.

name: Gentle Heart
summary: Mitia's kindness strengthens her magic and charm.

name: Iron Hide
summary: Half-orc/half-boar toughness. Thick skin.

name: Marksman's Eye
summary: Bowy's trained eye. Better accuracy and extended basic attack range.

name: Nine Tails
summary: Nine spirit-tails amplify her magic. Spell-lifesteal restores HP from every dark spell.

name: Oni Horns
summary: Cursed horns harden the Oni's crits — extra crit rate and devastating crit damage.

name: Unfeeling
summary: No nerves, no fear. Highly resistant to charm, fear, bleed, and pain-based effects.

name: Unholy Aura
summary: Pulses of dark energy fuel the necromancer's spells. Buffs nearby undead and refills mana.

name: Veteran's Instinct
summary: Decades of hunting hone reflexes. Counter chance on melee + perception.

name: Abominable
summary: Impervious to mundane weapons. Only fire, explosives, or boss-tier weapons deal real damage. Immune to most status effects.

name: Armored Flesh
summary: Layers of dead muscle absorb the first damage of any hit. Anything below the threshold just bounces off.

name: Low Profile
summary: Belly-down on the ground. Hard to hit with arrows, bullets, or any ranged weapon.

name: Toxic Aura
summary: Constantly leaks poison gas. Adjacent survivors take damage each round.

name: Unholy Focus
summary: Channels the Beacon's corruption. Massive mana regen and dark-spell amplification.

name: Walking Dead
summary: It's already dead. Doesn't bleed, doesn't fear, doesn't tire. But it burns.

name: Burnice Runner
summary: Burnice fights by reading routes before the horde closes. Better fire damage, movement, and snap-shot accuracy.
